Meet the founder & clinical lead

Olwethu Manana

Founder & Clinical Lead · Physiotherapist

Rehabilitation is about more than recovery — it is about helping people rediscover what is possible.

I am a physiotherapist with a deep passion for helping people move better, live more independently, and return to the activities that give their lives meaning.

I completed my community service at Carletonville Hospital, where I gained valuable hands-on experience in patient care, rehabilitation management and healthcare systems development. I later worked at a highly regarded physiotherapy practice in Gauteng, where I continued to develop clinically while working with patients from diverse backgrounds and with different rehabilitation needs.

My passion for community-based rehabilitation began during my studies at the University of KwaZulu-Natal, where I was awarded Best Student in Community Rehabilitation. I also served as Chairperson of the South African Society of Physiotherapy (SASP) student structure at UKZN, and was actively involved with the Imfume Clinic, participating in community screenings and assisting with patient assessment and care.

Sport has also become an important part of my professional journey. I serve as team medic for Young Lions F.C. in the Gauteng Development League, providing medical and rehabilitation support, injury-management guidance, and advice aimed at keeping players healthy and safely performing at their best.

My approach to rehabilitation

I believe every patient is more than their diagnosis or injury. That is why I take a holistic, patient-centred approach to rehabilitation — looking not only at physical recovery, but also at confidence, independence, lifestyle, personal goals and long-term wellbeing.

Whether someone wants to return to work, get back onto the sports field, move without pain, regain independence or simply feel more confident in their body, my role is to help create a practical and meaningful path towards that goal.

For me, success is not simply seeing a patient complete treatment. It is seeing them walk away stronger, more confident, better informed and equipped to continue moving forward. My purpose is simple: to use physiotherapy to create a positive impact — one person, one goal and one journey at a time.

About OLphysio

More Than Recovery. A Return to What Matters.

OLphysio is a physiotherapy practice committed to delivering thoughtful, accessible and clinically grounded care that helps people function at their best. Physiotherapy is not simply about treating a physical problem — it is about helping people navigate the impact that pain, injury, illness or physical limitation has on everyday life.

That is why our care is designed around the person, not just the condition. From assessment through rehabilitation, we take the time to understand each patient's circumstances, needs and objectives, then structure treatment to support practical improvements in movement, function and confidence.

Care Beyond the Clinic

OLphysio was established on the belief that quality physiotherapy should be easier to access and better connected to the realities of the people receiving it. Our mobile and home-based approach delivers physiotherapy within the patient's own environment where appropriate, which makes rehabilitation more practical and more relevant to their circumstances.

How We Deliver Care

  • Individualised rehabilitation programmes
  • Therapeutic exercise
  • Manual therapy where clinically appropriate
  • Mobility and functional rehabilitation
  • Pain management
  • Patient education and self-management
  • Progress monitoring and reassessment

What We Stand For

Clinical excellence, accessibility, professionalism, respect and meaningful patient outcomes. We want patients to understand their treatment, participate actively in their rehabilitation and feel supported throughout — and for physiotherapy to translate into something tangible beyond the treatment session: better movement, greater function and greater confidence in everyday life.
